title: The model's replies cannot be read for two turns running, then it recovers
expected: While the model's replies cannot be read the recap claims nothing is overlooked. Once it recovers, the work of the turns it failed on is recorded, and the requests the host wrote down in the meantime are not listed a second time in the model's words.

steps.user: Add a CSV export to the orders page and a date filter above the table.

steps.agent: Both are on the orders page: a date filter above the table and an Export CSV button that exports the filtered rows.

check.why: a recap the model could not write does not claim a request was overlooked

steps.user: make the date filter default to the last 30 days

steps.agent: The date filter defaults to the last 30 days now.

check.why: a recap the model could not write does not claim a request was overlooked

steps.user: and add a Reset button next to the filter

steps.agent: There is a Reset button next to the date filter now.

check.why: a good pass clears the degraded mark
nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the requests the host wrote down while the model failed are not listed again in the model's words
the work of the first turn the model failed on is recorded
the work of the second turn the model failed on is recorded
